en.title: [Field Placement Support Center] 2026 Fall Standard Field Placement Semester (Co-op) Student Information Session
summary: Notice regarding the 2026 Fall Standard Field Placement Semester (Co-op) Student Information Session.
The information session will be held on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in Session 1 (12:00–13:00) and Session 2 (17:00–18:00) at Building 7 (Student Center), Room 346.

Eligible participants are enrolled or leave-of-absence students (재/휴학생) who have completed 4 or more regular semesters as of the 2026 Fall semester; graduates and students who completed coursework without graduating (수료생) cannot apply.
Applications are accepted from Monday, November 2, 2026, until Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 23:59 via Google Forms (https://forms.gle/9xeEKQ3XL2YsUhs38).
Hamburgers will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis only to those who submit the Google Form application.
en.easyExplanation: An information session for the 2026 Fall Standard Field Placement Semester (Co-op) will be held on Wednesday, November 18 at the Student Center. Enrolled students or students on leave of absence who have completed 4 or more regular semesters as of the 2026 Fall semester may apply, while graduates and students who completed coursework without graduating (수료생) are excluded. Students wishing to attend must apply via Google Forms by Tuesday, November 10 at 23:59.

originalContent:
현장실습지원센터에서는 2026학년도 하반기 표준 현장실습학기제(Co-op) 학생 설명회를 아래와 같이 개최하오니, 관심 있는 학생들의 많은 참여 바랍니다.
1. 날짜 : 2026. 11. 18.(수)
2. 시간
1) 1차 : 12:00 ~ 13:00
2) 2차 : 17:00 ~ 18:00
3. 장소 : 7호관(학생회관) 346호
4. 대상 : 2026학년도 2학기 기준 정규학기 4학기 이상 이수한 재(휴)학생
※ 졸업생 및 수료생 신청 불가
5. 신청기간 : 2026. 11. 2.(월) ~ 11. 10.(화) 23:59까지
6. 신청방법 : 구글 설문지 https://forms.gle/9xeEKQ3XL2YsUhs38
※ 구글폼 제출자(신청자)에 한하여 선착순 햄버거 제공
7. 문의사항 : 현장실습지원센터 카카오톡 채널 또는 032-860-8440 ~ 3
